title: Fun to Read But Needs to be Proof Read!
text: Fun to Read But Needs to be Proof Read!. We just hosted a small gathering for a good friend to celebrate his 50th birthday. I ordered this specifically for decoration at the event. It's a nice quality. I wasn't expected it to be a canvas print. I've ordered others like this that were just flat posters. It was definitely fun to read, but it needs to be proof read! There are a few places without proper spacing. Then in the sports section, 4 times the word "champion" is misspelled. Instead it says "champinos". The spacing problem is one thing, but spelling mistakes is really not acceptable.
